title: Open and reload the Dashboards placeholder
steps: From the launcher, select the Dashboards card.
Confirm that the Dashboards page shows Under construction and Back to Launcher.
Reload the page and confirm that Under construction and Back to Launcher remain visible.
Select Back to Launcher to return to the launcher.
Confirm that the Dashboards card is visible.
reason: Document the delivered Dashboards placeholder, its reload-safe state, and the route back to the launcher.
